rootCause.detail: At a monthly rebalance the runner requested opening prices only for new target symbols. If an existing holding left the target set, rebalanceAtOpen valued that old holding with opens[symbol] undefined, producing NaN. JSON serialization converted NaN to null. Equal-weight9 was unaffected because it always retained all nine sectors.

changes: Rebalance opening-price request now uses union(current holdings, new targets).
rebalanceAtOpen and liquidateAtOpen now fail on missing/non-finite prices or values.
runner rejects non-finite economic blocks before evaluating gates.
pre-existing invalid result is archived as -invalid-technical-v1.json and recomputed from the same frozen Yahoo input.
